frozen_candidate_root_contribution: nSH = genuine, unfeigned good-faith orientation directed toward the proper good of / what is due to a party — surfacing (for human recipients) as sincere counsel, beneficial warning, or devoted caretaking, and (toward God) as loyal sincere devotion; by intensive-adjectival extension, the wholehearted genuineness of a (Godward) directed act.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: nSH = genuine, unfeigned good-faith orientation directed toward the proper good of / what is due to a party — surfacing (for human recipients) as sincere counsel, beneficial warning, or devoted caretaking, and (toward God) as loyal sincere devotion; by intensive-adjectival extension, the wholehearted genuineness of a (Godward) directed act.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across 12 of 13 occurrences the root construes its object through benefactive لِ (lakum, lahu, laka, lakumā, li-llāh), marking an act oriented FOR a party's good rather than performed ON a patient. It is not 'advice-content' (28:12 is devoted nursing of an infant; 9:91 is fidelity toward God, whom one cannot advise), and it is explicitly listed alongside — hence distinct from — message-conveyance (balāgh: 7:62, 7:79, 7:93) and from trustworthiness (amīn, listed separately at 7:68). It names the agent's good-faith stance, not the outcome: it can fail to benefit (11:34), be unloved (7:79), or be falsely sworn (7:21, 12:11). The lone intensive adjective naSūH (66:8), predicated of repentance with no beneficiary and no لِ, deploys only the genuineness component onto an act and forms a resistant lexicalized sub-class.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: nSH does NOT entail: (1) information/message transmission — coordinated with yet distinct from balāgh (7:62/79/93); (2) trustworthiness/amānah — listed as a separate co-attribute (7:68 nāSiḥ + amīn); (3) realized benefit or acceptance — offered yet unprofitable (11:34) and unloved (7:79); (4) truth of the claim — the participle is uttered by deceivers (7:21 Iblis, 12:11 brothers), so genuineness is predicated, not self-guaranteed; (5) verbal counsel specifically — applies to caretaking of an infant (28:12) and to loyalty toward God (9:91); (6) hierarchical direction — runs household→infant, commoner→Moses, believers→God.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 66:8:8:1 «تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا» — the sole ADJ (faʿūl intensive), sole non-لِ, sole occurrence with no directed party: nSH qualifies an act (repentance), not a recipient-directed relation. It resists the benefactive-directedness core and is accommodated only by abstracting to the bare 'genuineness/wholeheartedness of a (Godward) act', a bridge no verse in the packet forces. This resistant lexicalized adjectival sub-class caps the root claim below STRONG.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: Two-pole polysemy: Pole A = benevolent good-faith/loyalty enacted toward a party (the 12 لِ-directed verbs/participles/masdar); Pole B = purity/genuineness as an attribute of an act (naSūḥ, 66:8), with 9:91 li-llāh leaning Bward. The competitor holds these are distinct senses sharing a root, and the unifying 'authentic directed good-faith' is a broad abstraction chosen to fit both rather than a nucleus either pole compels. It is not decisively defeated Quran-internally, but it under-reads the pervasive benefactive لِ signature that binds Pole B's genuineness back to a directed act; 9:91 (good faith directed toward God) is the internal hinge that bridges human-directed counsel/care and the Godward genuineness of naSūḥ repentance, so a single bridged derivational family is preferred over unbridged homonymy.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Two-pole polysemy: Pole A = benevolent good-faith/loyalty enacted toward a party (the 12 لِ-directed verbs/participles/masdar); Pole B = purity/genuineness as an attribute of an act (naSūḥ, 66:8), with 9:91 li-llāh leaning Bward. The competitor holds these are distinct senses sharing a root, and the unifying 'authentic directed good-faith' is a broad abstraction chosen to fit both rather than a nucleus either pole compels. It is not decisively defeated Quran-internally, but it under-reads the pervasive benefactive لِ signature that binds Pole B's genuineness back to a directed act; 9:91 (good faith directed toward God) is the internal hinge that bridges human-directed counsel/care and the Godward genuineness of naSūḥ repentance, so a single bridged derivational family is preferred over unbridged homonymy.
internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses independently converge: a broad (12/13), distinctive (benefactive لِ; explicit separation from balāgh and amīn; the trust-presumption deceivers must counterfeit), adversarially clean interpersonal core, plus one resistant lexicalized ADJ (66:8). The narrowest distinctive claim ('sincere counsel to a human recipient') is falsified by 28:12 (nursing), 9:91 (devotion to God), and 66:8 (quality of an act), forcing the nucleus one level up to 'genuine good-faith orientation toward what is due to X'. Per the anti-over-grading discipline, a coherent resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class (66:8 naSūḥ) plus the need to abstract the unifying nucleus caps this at MODERATE + REPRESENTATIVE. The two false-claim cases (7:21, 12:11) confirm rather than break the core (the lie is about possessing the stance), and are recorded as adversarial boundaries. Result is bridged, not multi-class: a Quran-internal hinge (9:91) links the poles, so UNRESOLVED is not warranted.

clusters.classification_rationale: Every verbal (7:79:9:2, 7:93:9:2, 9:91:16:1 Form I; 11:34:7:1, 7:62:4:2 Form IV) and every nominal participle/masdar (7:68:6:1, 12:11:11:2, 28:12:16:1, 28:20:18:2, 7:21:5:2, 7:79:14:2, 11:34:3:1) construes its target through directional لِ (lakum/lahu/laka/lakumā/li-llāh), never a direct accusative patient. Form I vs Form IV shows no semantic contrast (Nuh's anSaḥu lakum 7:62 = Salih's naSaḥtu lakum 7:79 in identical messenger frames), and masdar nuSḥ names the same act as Form IV in one breath (11:34), so morphology does not partition sense here.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Distinctively separated from balāgh (7:62 «أُبَلِّغُكُمْ ... وَأَنصَحُ لَكُمْ»; 7:79, 7:93) and from amānah (7:68 «نَاصِحٌ أَمِينٌ», two listed attributes). Non-verbal caretaking (28:12 household nursing infant Musa) and Godward fidelity (9:91 «نَصَحُوا۟ لِلَّهِ») falsify the 'advice-content' gloss while remaining within directed good-faith.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Intensive faʿūl adjective naSūḥ: the wholehearted, unmixed genuineness of an act (repentance), abstracting the genuineness component of the root without a directed beneficiary.
clusters.classification_rationale: 66:8:8:1 «تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا» is the sole ADJ, predicated of an act with no لِ and no recipient. It cannot host the benefactive-directedness core and is bridged to C1 only inferentially via the shared genuineness component (and 9:91's Godward good-faith → repentance toward God). It is a lexicalized adjectival sub-class distinct from the verb/participle/masdar family.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: faʿūl intensive; the genuineness component that C1 carries alongside directedness surfaces here in isolation. The bridge is real but not text-forced, hence RESISTANT.

reconciliation.rationale: Resolved by pitching the nucleus at 'good-faith toward what is due to X'; welfare-seeking is the human-directed specialization, loyal devotion the Godward one. Retains the benefactive لِ signature, so it stays inside C1 and serves as the bridge to 66:8 rather than breaking the core.

No verse forces the bridge from directed good-faith to bare genuineness-of-an-act; as the sole ADJ with no beneficiary it is a lexicalized sub-class and is recorded as the resistant seam that caps grading at MODERATE.

adversarial_verification.notes: The interpersonal core (C1, 12/13) survives adversarial pressure — the two false-claim cases confirm rather than break it, and the balāgh/amīn contrasts hold — but the intensive ADJ naSūḥ (66:8) resists the benefactive-directedness core and requires abstraction, so a full adversarial refutation returning SUPPORTED with distinctiveness_ok=true and no failing occurrences cannot be claimed. Per protocol, resistance-with-holding-core is recorded as NOT_RUN, not PASSED.

occurrence_dispositions.reconciliation_rationale: No verse forces the bridge from directed good-faith to bare genuineness-of-an-act; as the sole ADJ with no beneficiary it is a lexicalized sub-class and is recorded as the resistant seam that caps grading at MODERATE.

occurrence_dispositions.note: Adversarial boundary: Iblis swears «إِنِّى لَكُمَا لَمِنَ ٱلنَّٰصِحِينَ» (reinforced by qāsama, an oath) while steering to the tree — the term denotes genuine directed good-faith, which is exactly why it is worth counterfeiting; the falsehood attaches to the speaker's claim, not to the lexeme.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Genuine good-faith directed toward the good of / what is due to a party (marked by benefactive لِ) — realized as sincere counsel, beneficial warning, devoted caretaking, or loyal devotion; names the agent's stance, not the outcome or its acceptance.
occurrence_dispositions.cluster_supporting_evidence: Distinctively separated from balāgh (7:62 «أُبَلِّغُكُمْ ... وَأَنصَحُ لَكُمْ»; 7:79, 7:93) and from amānah (7:68 «نَاصِحٌ أَمِينٌ», two listed attributes). Non-verbal caretaking (28:12 household nursing infant Musa) and Godward fidelity (9:91 «نَصَحُوا۟ لِلَّهِ») falsify the 'advice-content' gloss while remaining within directed good-faith.
occurrence_dispositions.preliminary_note: Every verbal (7:79:9:2, 7:93:9:2, 9:91:16:1 Form I; 11:34:7:1, 7:62:4:2 Form IV) and every nominal participle/masdar (7:68:6:1, 12:11:11:2, 28:12:16:1, 28:20:18:2, 7:21:5:2, 7:79:14:2, 11:34:3:1) construes its target through directional لِ (lakum/lahu/laka/lakumā/li-llāh), never a direct accusative patient. Form I vs Form IV shows no semantic contrast (Nuh's anSaḥu lakum 7:62 = Salih's naSaḥtu lakum 7:79 in identical messenger frames), and masdar nuSḥ names the same act as Form IV in one breath (11:34), so morphology does not partition sense here.

resistant_deep_analysis.preliminary_note: 66:8:8:1 «تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا» is the sole ADJ, predicated of an act with no لِ and no recipient. It cannot host the benefactive-directedness core and is bridged to C1 only inferentially via the shared genuineness component (and 9:91's Godward good-faith → repentance toward God). It is a lexicalized adjectival sub-class distinct from the verb/participle/masdar family.
resistant_deep_analysis.reconciliation_rationale: No verse forces the bridge from directed good-faith to bare genuineness-of-an-act; as the sole ADJ with no beneficiary it is a lexicalized sub-class and is recorded as the resistant seam that caps grading at MODERATE.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, C) converged on the same partition, the same resistant seam (66:8), and the same MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE grade.
candidate_root_contribution: nSH = genuine, unfeigned good-faith orientation directed toward the proper good of / what is due to a party — surfacing (for human recipients) as sincere counsel, beneficial warning, or devoted caretaking, and (toward God) as loyal sincere devotion; by intensive-adjectival extension, the wholehearted genuineness of a (Godward) directed act.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 13 confirmed occurrences: 5 V (Form I naSaḥa 7:79:9:2, 7:93:9:2, 9:91:16:1; Form IV anSaḥa 11:34:7:1, 7:62:4:2), 7 N (participles nāSiḥ/nāSiḥūn/nāSiḥīn 7:68:6:1, 12:11:11:2, 28:12:16:1, 28:20:18:2, 7:21:5:2, 7:79:14:2 + masdar nuSḥ 11:34:3:1), 1 ADJ (naSūḥ 66:8:8:1). qac_verb_form is null throughout.
layer_attribution.derivation: One bridged derivational family: verb (I/IV, semantically non-contrastive) + active participle + masdar all share the benefactive-directed good-faith nucleus; the faʿūl intensive adjective extends the genuineness component to an act. Bridge hinge: 9:91 (Godward good-faith).
layer_attribution.lexical_class: C2 naSūḥ (66:8) is a resistant lexicalized adjectival sub-class (faʿūl intensive on تَوْبَة) distinct from the C1 verb/participle/masdar family; its resistance caps scope at REPRESENTATIVE and strength at MODERATE.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Narrative/legal contexts (prophetic self-descriptions, household caretaking, warning to Moses, the tawba injunction, the exemption clause) supply the specific manifestations (counsel, warning, nursing, loyalty, repentance) — these are contextual realizations and must NOT be elevated into the root claim, which stays at 'genuine directed good-faith'.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: 9:91 reconciled from preliminary RESISTANT to CONSISTENT by abstracting the nucleus; 66:8 reconciled from candidate CONSISTENT to final RESISTANT for lack of a text-forced bridge. Deception cases (7:21, 12:11) reconciled as CONSISTENT adversarial boundaries.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: 66:8:8:1 (naSūḥ) persists as the resistant seam — genuine but bridged only by abstraction to the intensive genuineness of a Godward act; recorded, not forced into the interpersonal core.

hard_cases.reason: Sole ADJ (faʿūl intensive), sole non-لِ, sole occurrence with no directed party; nSH qualifies an act (repentance) not a recipient-directed relation, and is accommodated only by abstracting to the bare genuineness of a Godward act.

evidence_basis.statement: 66:8:8:1 «تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحًا» — the sole ADJ (faʿūl intensive), sole non-لِ, sole occurrence with no directed party: nSH qualifies an act (repentance), not a recipient-directed relation.

hard_cases.reason: The participle is sworn falsely by Iblis, showing nSH names a predicated good-faith stance whose truth is not self-guaranteed.

evidence_basis.statement: Iblis swears «إِنِّى لَكُمَا لَمِنَ ٱلنَّٰصِحِينَ» (reinforced by qāsama, an oath) while steering to the tree — the term denotes genuine directed good-faith, which is exactly why it is worth counterfeiting; the falsehood attaches to the speaker's claim, not to the lexeme.

hard_cases.reason: Yusuf's brothers claim nāSiḥūn status while plotting harm — same morphology as genuine cases; falsity is contextual, not lexical.

evidence_basis.statement: Yusuf's brothers assert «وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَنَٰصِحُونَ» while plotting the well — identical morphology to the genuine nāSiḥūn of 28:12; the predicated good-faith stance is asserted, its truth context-determined, not encoded.

hard_cases.reason: Directs nSH at God, forcing the nucleus above 'benefit-seeking' to 'loyal good-faith toward what is due to X'; serves as the bridge to the naSūḥ sub-class.

evidence_basis.statement: «نَصَحُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ» directs nSH at God, who cannot be 'benefited/advised', forcing the nucleus up to 'loyal good-faith toward what is due to X'; this is the internal hinge bridging human-directed counsel/care with the Godward genuineness of naSūḥ (66:8).

hard_case_representation.rationale: Each hard case is grounded in a specific packet occurrence's morphology/syntax: the RESISTANT_SEAM (66:8) is the sole ADJ outside the لِ pattern; the two ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY cases (7:21, 12:11) are false predications of the participle; the STRUCTURAL_ATYPICALITY (9:91) is the God-directed target. Statements are mirrored in strongest_counterexample and the occurrence/cluster notes.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quranic occurrence of nSH that construes its object as a direct accusative patient (act performed ON someone, e.g. correcting/informing them) rather than through benefactive لِ / directed orientation, OR an occurrence where nSH clearly means neutral information-transfer coextensive with balāgh rather than an accompanying good-faith stance.
rejection_condition.search_location: All 5 verbal forms (7:79:9:2, 7:93:9:2, 9:91:16:1, 11:34:7:1, 7:62:4:2) for accusative-patient construal, and the balāgh-coordinated verses (7:62, 7:79, 7:93) to test whether nSH collapses into message-conveyance.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read qac_surface_form and verse_text to confirm the complement marker (لِ vs accusative) and whether nSH is coordinated with (distinct from) or appositive to a balāgh verb; check that no occurrence makes nSH the content delivered rather than the stance accompanying delivery.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Exclude context-supplied meaning: the messenger-narrative setting supplies 'preaching', but the root claim must rest on the لِ construal and the explicit balāgh-vs-naSaḥa coordination, not on the surrounding prophetic frame; do not let high frequency of the counsel-manifestation be read as the lexical core.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If accusative-patient or pure information-transfer construal is confirmed, the benefactive-directedness core is falsified, the nucleus collapses toward generic 'advise/inform', and grading drops to WEAK or the account is REJECTED.

reopen_conditions: If a future occurrence or re-reading shows naSūḥ (66:8) construing a directed party (لِ/ilā a beneficiary) rather than qualifying an act, the C2 sub-class would merge into the C1 nucleus and grading could rise toward STRONG.

If an occurrence establishes a genuine Form I vs Form IV (naSaḥa vs anSaḥa) semantic contrast — currently absent (cf. 7:62 anSaḥu lakum vs 7:79 naSaḥtu lakum in identical frames) — the single-nucleus derivational-family reading must be re-partitioned.

If 9:91 (naSaḥū li-llāh) is shown NOT to bridge the human-directed and Godward-genuineness poles, the two-pole polysemy competitor strengthens and the result should be reconsidered as UNRESOLVED/multi-class.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The interpersonal core (C1, 12/13) survives adversarial pressure — the two false-claim cases confirm rather than break it, and the balāgh/amīn contrasts hold — but the intensive ADJ naSūḥ (66:8) resists the benefactive-directedness core and requires abstraction, so a full adversarial refutation returning SUPPORTED with distinctiveness_ok=true and no failing occurrences cannot be claimed. Per protocol, resistance-with-holding-core is recorded as NOT_RUN, not PASSED.
